finalPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production sprite atlas for Dream Town. Match existing cozy painterly isometric town art: creamy plaster, terracotta roofs, dark oak, jewel green foliage, soft sunlight from upper left, polished hand painted 3D illustration, crisp readable silhouettes. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 sprites in strict row-major order. Equal sized cells, each subject centered, at least 15 percent empty padding on EVERY side inside every cell. No sprite crosses its cell. Row 1: friendly small brass-and-wood automaton assistant bust portrait; ornate ivory mouse cursor arrow idle; same cursor with golden selection spark; same cursor holding miniature hammer. Row 2: single carved wood badge showing guiding hand for assisted mode; single carved wood badge showing handshake for collaborative mode; single carved wood badge showing small gear for autonomous mode; director badge showing vintage film camera. No text, letters or numbers. UI icons, no ground bases. Exactly one icon per cell. Genuinely transparent alpha background and gutters. No checkerboard, solid background, captions, typography, watermarks or grid lines. No extra sprites. Whole subjects, no clipping. Buildings on small individual isometric grass/stone foundations. Aim for 2048px wide high quality sheet.
